|game_text='''0 side — City In The Clouds'''

Deploy Bespin system and a Cloud City battleground site. While this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Cloud City battleground site. Flip this card if you control two Cloud City battleground sites and occupy Bespin system, and opponent controls no Cloud City sites.

'''7 side — You Truly Belong Here With Us'''

While this side up, once per game, may ▼ Cloud City Celebration. Once during your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ one Interrupt. Once per turn, may move your character as a 'react' to a battle or Force drain at a Cloud City site. Flip this card if opponent controls more Cloud City sites than you.
|errata_history=This is the original printing: the PC card image current at the set's official release, first published 8 July 2018. * '''PC-E1''' ([[City In The Clouds / You Truly Belong Here With Us (Errata)]]): PC card images of 12 December 2022<ref name="ht-ci-1">PC card images in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/cityintheclouds.gif cityintheclouds.gif], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/youtrulybelongherewithus.gif youtrulybelongherewithus.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca 12d0bca] (12 December 2022).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: re-rendered by the PC in its current card style (new frame and text font); PC errata of December 2022 (marked “E1”, Virtual Set P): the 0 side adds “May deploy Weather Vane.” and its download takes “a Cloud City battleground” (was “… battleground site”); the 7 side's “▲ one Interrupt” becomes “▲ an Interrupt”; the margins become “Leia Of Alderaan” on both sides. Text: “City In The Clouds: Deploy Bespin system and a Cloud City battleground site. May deploy Weather Vane. While this side up, once per turn, may use 1 Force to ▼ a Cloud City battleground. Flip this card if you control two Cloud City battleground sites and occupy Bespin system, and opponent controls no Cloud City sites. You Truly Belong Here With Us: While this side up, once per game, may ▼ Cloud City Celebration. Once during your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ an Interrupt. Once per turn, may move your character as a 'react' to a battle or Force drain at a Cloud City site. Flip this card if opponent controls more Cloud City sites than you.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). The first image is the PC's Demo Deck card (Demo Deck released 24 February 2017; the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018).
